content: For fuzzy/duplicate matching: string-similarity npm package is deprecated ('no longer supported'). fuse.js (7.5.0) is actively maintained and good for client-side fuzzy search. For server-side duplicate detection against an existing DB table, Postgres's built-in pg_trgm extension (similarity() function) is preferable - free, no new dependency, keeps full-table comparison server-side/RLS-scoped instead of shipping data to the browser.
